name: Doosan Skoda Power as
summary: Doosan Skoda Power s.r.o. specializes in the entire lifecycle of steam turbines and associated machinery, encompassing engineering, design, manufacturing, project management, procurement, construction, and supply throughout the Czech Republic, Europe, and Asia. Beyond core production, the company offers comprehensive support, including installation, ongoing maintenance, corrective repairs, major overhauls, and extended service agreements. Its diverse service portfolio further includes power generation solutions, specialized engineering, system retrofitting and modernization, precision machining, thermal treatment, welding and assembly, heat exchanger services, laboratory analysis, and direct on-site assistance. Products are marketed under the established Doosan and Škoda brand names. The firm caters to a wide array of industrial sectors, such as waste-to-energy facilities, public utilities, pulp and paper manufacturers, mining operations, refineries, steel mills, and chemical processing plants. Established in 1869 and headquartered in Plzeň, Czech Republic, Doosan Skoda Power s.r.o. operates as a subsidiary of Doosan Power Systems S.A.
